title: Aparā
text: 2. Cattāro me bhikkhave iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā aparāparaṃ gamanāya {saṃvattanti} || Katame cattāro || || 3. Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgatam iddhipādam bhāveti || viriyasamādhipadhānasaṅkharasamannāgatam iddhipādam bhāveti || cittasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgatam iddhipādam bhāveti || vīmaṃsasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādam bhāveti || || Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā aparāparaṅgamanāya saṃvattantī ti || ||
